title: Manifold-based Dynamic Memory (MDM): extractive recall over a message archive
description: Extractive recall over a personal message archive. Keyword queries return a short, ordered, de-duplicated passage with provenance pointers, with honest refusal when no relevant memory exists, and an MCP server exposing recall/remember/stats. The shipped index is a lexical baseline (TF-IDF over character bigrams); the manifold-based representation is the research target. No data is included in the repository.
